MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Adele’s expressive ballads fit the strong voices and melodic songs I enjoy in my vocal albums.",
    "If The Perfect Gift and It's the Girls! are the albums I recognize, their polished singing and familiar melodies feel like natural companions to my listening."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "1989 feels brighter and more energetic than the relaxed orchestral or vocal music I want right now.",
    "In The Lonely Hour and Pain Killer connect with parts of my taste, but that does not make them what I would choose today.",
    "I cannot confidently connect Playing With Fire, Anything Goes, or Greatest Hits, Vol. 1 and 2 to my preferences without knowing the artists."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to count too strongly as a reason to offer more seasonal music, even though I am not specifically seeking it now.",
    "Enjoying some pop and country albums seems to have been taken as a broad preference, when the voice, melody, and mood matter more to my choice."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest choice of relaxing classical music suggests that gentleness and a calm atmosphere deserve more weight right now.",
    "I need a recognizable performer or a clear musical connection to choose confidently; a familiar-sounding album title alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices capture my interest in expressive voices and melody, but miss how much my current preference for calm listening narrows what I would choose."
}
